policy.name: NO_NEW_EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES
policy.scope: Archive routes that require recruiting or obtaining a commitment from a teammate, adviser, referee, partner, host, principal investigator, institution, registered entity, company or external validator before a valid application can be made.
policy.not_archived: Ordinary external review after application, applicant accounts, applicant-authored documents, CAPTCHA/OTP, declarations, fees and final submission gates do not by themselves trigger this archive.
policy.restore_condition: The user reopens the relevant external dependency or official rules remove it.
